cohort: The study included 88 females aged 20-40 years who underwent emergency obstetric hysterectomy at a tertiary care hospital.
finding: Cesarean sections were identified as the main contributing factor to emergency obstetric hysterectomy, leading to placental abnormalities, uterine rupture, and adherent placenta.
mod_finding: A previous history of cesarean section was mainly associated with adhered placenta, which was a significant cause of emergency obstetric hysterectomy.
